440|באוהל, כל כבודה בת מלך פנימה.|In the tent — "all the honor of the king's daughter is within."|Na tenda — "toda a glória da filha do rei está no interior."
441|האישה בתוך האוהל.|The woman is inside the tent.|A mulher fica dentro da tenda.
442|עכשיו, שרה, שמחה, יש אורחים.|Now, Sarah, rejoice, we have guests.|Agora, Sará, alegre-se, temos hóspedes.
443|ויאמר מה ארי, שלוש שאים קמח סולת לושי והסיוגות.|"Hasten! Three measures of fine flour, knead and make cakes."|"Apressa-te! Três medidas de farinha fina, amassa e faz bolos."
444|זאת אומרת, הוא אומר לשרה, תראי, הגיעו אורחים, בואי מהר, מהר, מהר, תעשי לאורחים|That is, he tells Sarah, look, guests have arrived, come quickly, quickly, quickly, make for the guests|Ou seja, ele diz a Sará: olha, chegaram hóspedes, venha depressa, depressa, depressa, faça para os hóspedes
445|עוגות.|cakes.|bolos.
446|מה זה קמח סולת?|What is "kemach solet"?|O que é "kemach solet"?
447|סולת, זה הכי משובח בקמח, זה קוסקוס.|Solet is the finest part of the flour, like couscous.|Solet é a parte mais fina da farinha, como cuscuz.
448|הוא אומר, תקחי את הסולת, את הכי משובח, ותעשי להם עוגות.|He says, take the solet, the finest, and make them cakes.|Ele diz: pegue a solet, a mais fina, e faça bolos para eles.
449|עכשיו, בואו נשאל אתכם, גבר בבית, באו לו החבר'ה, האורחים.|Now let me ask you: a man at home, the guys come over, the guests.|Agora, vou perguntar a vocês: um homem em casa, chegam os amigos, os hóspedes.
450|נכנס למטבח, אומר לאשתו, מהרי, מהרי, תעשי פה כיבוד לאורחים.|He walks into the kitchen and tells his wife, hurry, hurry, prepare refreshments for the guests.|Entra na cozinha e diz à esposa: depressa, depressa, prepare um lanche para os hóspedes.|
451|איזה גבר, יעז לעשות את זה.|What man would dare do that?|Que homem ousaria fazer isso?
452|אבל שרה אימנו היא צדיקה, גם היא רוצה, מה שנקרא, להשתתף במצווה.|But Sarah our matriarch is a tzaddika; she too wants to take part in the mitzvah.|Mas Sará, nossa matriarca, é uma tsadika; ela também quer participar da mitsvá.
453|אבל יש עוד הסבר למה הוא אומר למרי.|But there is another explanation for why he says "hasten."|Mas há outra explicação para o motivo de ele dizer "apressa-te".
454|אומרים לנו חז"ל שזה היה פסח.|Our Sages tell us that it was Pesach.|Nossos Sábios dizem que era Pessach.
455|איך פסח?|How, Pesach?|Como, Pessach?
456|בני ישראל עוד לא נולדו, עוד לא ירדו למצרים, ובטח עוד לא יצאו ממצרים.|The Children of Israel were not yet born, had not yet gone down to Egypt, and certainly had not yet left Egypt.|Os filhos de Israel ainda não tinham nascido, ainda não tinham descido ao Egito, e certamente ainda não tinham saído do Egito.
457|אז איך פסח?|So how, Pesach?|Então como, Pessach?
458|אנחנו יודעים שהאבות קיימו את כל התורה כולה מתוך עצמם.|We know that the Patriarchs kept the entire Torah on their own.|Sabemos que os Patriarcas cumpriram toda a Torá por conta própria.
459|הם היה להם רוח הקודש.|They had divine inspiration.|Eles tinham inspiração divina.
460|וזה היה בדיוק זמן פסח.|And it was exactly the time of Pesach.|E era exatamente a época de Pessach.
461|אז בפסח יש בעיה.|So on Pesach there is a problem.|Então em Pessach há um problema.
462|מה הבעיה?|What is the problem?|Qual é o problema?
463|אסור שהבצק יחמיץ.|The dough must not become chametz.|A massa não pode fermentar.
464|כמה זמן בצק עומד עד שמחמיץ?|How long can dough sit before it becomes chametz?|Quanto tempo a massa pode ficar parada até fermentar?
465|18 דקות.|Eighteen minutes.|Dezoito minutos.
466|אבל אם אתה לש את הבצק, אז הוא לא מחמיץ.|But if you keep kneading the dough, it doesn't become chametz.|Mas se você continua amassando a massa, ela não fermenta.
467|אז מה הוא אומר לה?|So what does he tell her?|Então o que ele diz a ela?
468|מהרי, שלא יחמיץ הבצק, שלוש סאים קמח סולת, לושי, כדי שלא|Hurry, so the dough won't become chametz: three measures of fine flour, knead, so that|Depressa, para que a massa não fermente: três medidas de farinha fina, amasse, para que não|
469|יצא שהבצק יחמיץ.|it won't happen that the dough becomes chametz.|aconteça de a massa fermentar.
470|בגלל זה הוא מזרז אותה.|That is why he urges her on.|Por isso ele a apressa.
471|לא שהוא בא למה שנקרא לרדוד בחס ושלום.|Not that he came to order her around, heaven forbid.|Não que ele quisesse mandar nela, Deus me livre.
472|כדי שלא יצא מצב שיחמיץ הבצק.|just so the dough wouldn't end up becoming chametz.|só para que a massa não acabasse fermentando.
473|עכשיו, מה זה אמרנו?|Now, what did we say?|Agora, o que dissemos?
474|שתפרידי את הסולת מהקמח.|That she should separate the solet from the flour.|Que ela separe a solet da farinha.
475|עכשיו, בינתיים, מה עושה אברהם?|Now, meanwhile, what is Avraham doing?|Agora, enquanto isso, o que Avraham faz?
476|זה לא שהוא הולך לנוח.|It's not that he goes to rest.|Não é que ele vá descansar.
477|כתוב, ואל הבקר רץ אברהם, וייקח בן בקר רך וטוב, וייתן אל הנער, וימהר לעשות|It is written: "And Avraham ran to the herd, and took a tender and good calf, and gave it to the youth, who hurried to prepare|Está escrito: "E Avraham correu ao gado, e tomou um bezerro tenro e bom, e o deu ao jovem, que se apressou a preparar|
478|אותו.|it."|o."
479|זאת אומרת, אברהם בפשט רץ אל הרפת,|That is, Avraham, in the plain meaning, runs to the cattle barn,|Ou seja, Avraham, no sentido simples, corre ao curral,
